AccountingCustomerParty.absent: No buyer; serializer may emit the existing empty Party placeholder.
AccountingCustomerParty.valid_partial: A modeled buyer has a name; address, VAT registration and identifiers are independent.
AccountingCustomerParty.malformed_present: Nonempty customer content without Party, or a nonempty Party without its required modeled name, fails.

PostalAddress.absent: Allowed for buyer; required for seller construction.
PostalAddress.valid_partial: Buyer address may omit basic components but must have a country; omitted components use the existing empty-string API convention.
PostalAddress.malformed_present: Missing country, malformed country code or blank supplied basic components fails.

Delivery.valid_partial: Empty, actual-only, latest-only or both dates are retained; chronology is a business-rule concern.
Delivery.malformed_present: Malformed supplied dates or duplicate modeled children fails.

PaymentMeans.valid_partial: Code required; ordered instructions and financial account optional.
PaymentMeans.malformed_present: Missing code or duplicate singleton children fails.

PayeeFinancialAccount.valid_partial: Empty, identifier-only, terms-only or both supported fields retained.

PartyIdentification.valid_partial: ID required; schemeID optional; repeated identifiers preserved.
PartyIdentification.malformed_present: Missing ID or duplicate ID fails.

PartyTaxScheme.valid_partial: When supplied for a buyer, CompanyID required; supported tax scheme is VAT.
PartyTaxScheme.malformed_present: Missing buyer CompanyID or a supplied non-VAT TaxScheme ID fails.

OrderReference.malformed_present: Missing ID or duplicate singleton fails.

ContractDocumentReference.malformed_present: Missing ID or duplicate singleton fails.

BillingReference.absent: No original invoice reference; business rules decide conditional requirement.
BillingReference.valid_partial: InvoiceDocumentReference with ID required; UUID/date/time optional.
BillingReference.malformed_present: Missing reference ID, malformed supplied date/time or duplicate singleton fails.

DocumentReference.valid_partial: ID required; type/date/time optional; type 386 selects prepayment-adjustment treatment.
DocumentReference.malformed_present: Missing ID or malformed supplied metadata fails.

AllowanceCharge.valid_partial: Line/document adjustments require indicator and amount; document adjustments require VAT allocation; base and percentage are paired.
AllowanceCharge.malformed_present: Incomplete calculation pair, inconsistent supplied amount or malformed allocation fails.

Price/AllowanceCharge.valid_partial: Discount Amount and gross BaseAmount required; resulting net price must agree.
Price/AllowanceCharge.malformed_present: Missing gross or discount, charge instead of allowance, or inconsistent net price fails.

Price.valid_partial: PriceAmount required; positive BaseQuantity and its unit optional.
Price.malformed_present: Missing or invalid price, nonpositive basis or inconsistent gross/discount metadata fails.

StandardItemIdentification.valid_partial: ID required; supplied scheme preserved; business rules check its conditional requirement.

InvoiceLine/TaxTotal.absent: Absence retained; computed internal values do not fabricate the container.
InvoiceLine/TaxTotal.valid_partial: TaxAmount required; gross RoundingAmount and prepayment subtotals optional.
InvoiceLine/TaxTotal.malformed_present: Empty present total, malformed money or inconsistent gross fails.

Invoice/TaxTotal.absent: Document breakdown total required; scalar accounting total may be absent.
Invoice/TaxTotal.valid_partial: One breakdown total and at most one scalar accounting total; source order retained.
Invoice/TaxTotal.malformed_present: Missing breakdown, duplicate totals, malformed amounts or inconsistent accepted sums fails.

TaxSubtotal.absent: No subtotal occurrence; required document groups cannot be omitted.
TaxSubtotal.valid_partial: TaxableAmount, TaxAmount and category required; exemption code and text independently optional.
TaxSubtotal.malformed_present: Malformed amounts, conflicting group metadata or rule-specific monetary inconsistency fails.
